conviction_note: A small negative lean on the forward DPU guide: the April forecast was struck on 1M TIBOR as of 2026-02-27 with only 55.4% of debt fixed, and the BOJ has since raised the policy rate from 0.75% to 1.25% (June and September), which on the company's own numbers is roughly 100 yen (about 3%) off the period-18 DPU before any offset. The reported period has beaten its latest forecast by about 2.2% at each of the last two prints and the stock fell about 0.4% both times, so the beat carries almost no weight. The two numbers agree in sign. The scaled move is small because this name moves about 0.4% on its prints and the rate path is public.
bar: Company forecast for period 17 (Aug-2026) DPU 3,343 yen and period 18 (Feb-2027) DPU 3,143 yen, from the 2026-02 決算短信 of 2026-04-17 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260417/140120260417505999.pdf). There is no consensus or IFIS number for this name (Yahoo earningsHistory is empty), so the bar is the company plan only and every size is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: no disclosed position at or above 0.5% (as of 2026-10-16, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用残 on kabutan as of 10/09: margin sells 1 unit, margin buys 4,359 units, so 信用倍率 4,359x (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=3488). The ratio itself means nothing with 1 unit short, but 4,359 units is about 1.7% of the 262,790 units outstanding and roughly 4 days of the name's ~1,000-unit daily volume, so the margin long is crowded relative to turnover and a visible guide-down could still find sellers. There is no options market and so no skew. Baseline priced_lean_pct -1.83, almost all of it margin_overhang.

findings.finding: The forecasts due at this print (a revised period 18 and a new period 19) face a rate headwind the April guide did not include. Per the April 2026 presentation, the 2026-03 borrowing cut the fixed-rate ratio to 55.4% of 25.2bn yen of debt and floating rates were set on 1M TIBOR as of 2026-02-27. The BOJ has since gone from 0.75% to 1.25%. On about 11.2bn yen of floating debt, +0.5pp over 181 days is about 28m yen, or about 106 yen a unit (about 3.4% of the 3,143-yen period-18 DPU). A new period-19 guide also carries the Sapporo Odori vacancy and full expensing of property tax on the March acquisitions, so it is likely to come in below 3,143 unless leasing or an asset sale offsets it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-04-17 (15:30): period-18 DPU was cut 160 yen (-4.8%) against the March notice, mainly for the Sapporo Odori exit. Close 4/17 to 4/20 was -0.36%, then -1.26% on 4/21. 2025-10-17: the next period was guided at 3,171 against an actual 3,226, and close to next close was -0.42% (Yahoo chart https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/3488.T?range=2y&interval=1d).
findings.why_not_priced: The rate path is public, but the per-unit translation needs the floating ratio and the base-rate date from this REIT's own presentation, and nobody covers it: no consensus exists and the market cap is 27.8bn yen. If the cut were priced, the stock would have fallen after the 2026-09-18 hike. Instead it rose from 102,800 (9/09) to 105,600, trades at about 1.0x book NAV of 103,224 yen and yields 6.33% on the 3,343-yen DPU that is about to roll off.
findings.independence: BOJ 1.0% to 1.25% on 2026-09-18 (Daiwa Institute of Research, https://www.dir.co.jp/report/research/economics/japan/20260918_026078.html). The interest-cost line was already rising in the April guide: non-operating interest 190m yen in period 17 and 212m in period 18, on the base-rate assumption (2026-02 決算短信, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260417/140120260417505999.pdf). Both rest on the same company debt profile.

findings.finding: Period 17's reported DPU is likely to beat the 3,343-yen forecast modestly. The last two periods beat their latest forecast by 2.1-2.2% (3,226 against 3,160; 3,238 against 3,171) on hotel variable rent and cost control. A June hike over July-August (about 18 yen) trims the beat to perhaps 1%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Both of the last two beats were sold: -0.42% (2025-10-17 to 10-20) and -0.36% (2026-04-17 to 04-20).
findings.why_not_priced: It mostly is: the beat is a habit, it lands inside the guided range and the stock sold it both times. It is filed small for completeness.
findings.independence: The 2025-10-17 kabutan result article shows the same pattern (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3488&b=k202510170017).

outside_window.finding: BOJ expected to go to 1.5% in December 2026 and 1.75% in Q1 2027 (DIR forecast). That would further raise the cost of the floating debt and the refinancing of the 3,800m short-term and 4,350m long-term loans due in period 18.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: a period-18 revision is likely, leaning down on interest, against 3,143 yen. Returns: no buyback history, and a payout of 100% of earnings leaves no lever. New guide: a period-19 forecast arrives at this print with no market number to compare it to, likely below 3,143 unless re-leasing or an asset sale offsets it. Reported period: a DPU beat of about 1-2% against 3,343 is the habit and has been sold.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Sapporo Odori large-tenant exit as a separate negative
rejected_candidates.detail: Already inside the April period-18 guide (-329 yen). Its only remaining effect is on the new period-19 guide, which the guidance finding covers.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Hotel variable rent at Sendai and KH Sapporo as an upside
rejected_candidates.detail: This is the driver of the habitual beat in the reported-period finding; there is no separate dated series for March-August 2026.

baseline_tension: The finding agrees with the baseline's negative lean (margin overhang -1.82) and cuts slightly against the flat 20-day run-up (+0.28%). The strongest positive this release could carry is a held or raised period-18 forecast from re-leasing Sapporo Odori, or an asset sale with a gain that props up DPU. I looked in the TDnet record and found neither announced, and an acquisition with a unit offering could be announced in the same batch, which is unknowable.
lessons_applied: Rule 1: the BOJ path is a public series, but the release is likely to ADD a forecast change, so the guidance finding was trimmed only slightly (-0.6 to -0.5) and p_up moved from 40 to 42.
Rule 2: the strongest positive (a held guide via re-leasing or an asset-sale gain) is written in baseline_tension; I looked in TDnet and found none, so p_up moved only a little further.
The reported-period finding was left as it was.
